avis.texte: I can not believe the reviews on this product. The directions literally say and I quote “Open pouch and take out the sheet, then REMOVE PROTECTIVE FILM FROM ONE SIDE. After cleaning dry your face and applying sheet, adjusting it to fit the shape of your face. Then, REMOVE REMAINING PROTECTIVE FILM.” How can you think you’re doing it correctly when the whole mask won’t even lay against your skin. Even then you didn’t think to check the directions? 🫩 The mask itself is amazing. It really does clean out your pores. Don’t expect a pore strip experience. This is not that. Pore strips damage your pores. Medicube would never. This is a will get into your pores and melt away debris. It will leave your skin extremely soft and healthy looking.

Did not fit my face at all and the mask was very stiff so it does not lay on skin well. I ended up having to cut it into pieces which made me waste a lot of the product and lost of my face still isn’t touching the mask

Guys seriously. Read. Hell, gonwatch the how to video if all else fails. There are literally 3 pieces. 2 protective sheets(the stiffnones ya'll are complaining about) and then the sheet itself that you arebsupposed to use. I am currently wearing my first one. The smell reminds me of apple. Its pleasant. The sheet formed pwrfectly to my face. And hasnt once moved. I dig it. I will add to with results later. Its absolutely the best mask like this ive tried as far as non moving and fit.

I was influenced to buy this on TikTok and I am glad I did. It was easy to use and I immediately saw results. No irritation and I have sensitive skin. Very easy to take off and my pores on my nose are noticeable smaller. I swear this works!!!

Was expecting more tbh - it got some stuff out but I could still see clogged pores on my skin after. For the price point I don’t think it did enough to make me want to repurchase. Really sad because I love medicube but this product wasn’t for me

Don’t give into the hype. After listening to the instructions, the paper won’t stay on my face. This is my 2nd try. It also does not do as promised and “purge” my face after one use. It didn’t add glow other than being wet-ish after. It didn’t irritate my skin which is a plus I guess. But don’t waste your money.
Haven’t really seen a difference yet but haven’t really had time to give it a chance
Felt good but i don’t think it helped my acne as the TikTok shop says

There are THREE LAYERS! The first mask I done incorrectly, I didn’t read the directions and thought the mask didn’t fit. You must remove the first layer, place the mask, then remove the top protective layer. I have included a short video of the layers, pictures of the mask first on, peeling the protective layer, after the mask is dried and being removed and after soaking in water to see what impurities it pulled out. It was comfortable while wearing, didn’t hurt to remove. I would recommend the mask, I plan to buy more for my teenage daughters.

I’m a fan of Medicube products and have tried a few before, but this was my first time using their sheet mask. It’s a peel-off style mask that felt gentle on my skin. You definitely need to follow the instructions closely since it’s not a standard single-layer sheet mask. It was pretty interesting to use, there are multiple layers, and after removing it, you can see the results by wetting the used sheet. It’s designed to lift away surface buildup without any harsh pulling or squeezing, so it doesn’t give the same effect as a pore strip. The price is a bit higher compared to other sheet masks and Medicube’s daily products since there were only 3 sheets, but it’s still nice to try something new and different.

I'm not sure that these masks are a good fit for me, in more ways than one. First, the shape and style of the mask itself. I had a lot of trouble getting this mask to lay flat against my skin and not bunch up. Part of that is due to the slightly stiffer than usual mask material (It makes me think sort of like wonton skin or rice noodles, if that makes sense), and part of it is just the shape of my face vs the shape of the mask. I had to cut additional darts along the side to make it sit more flush against my cheeks. The mask itself is sandwiched between two textured layers, and I found it a little difficult to separate them. Normally I find sheet masks to be soothing, but this one is sort of stiff and slightly sticky. I'm sure it's doing nice things for my skin, but between it being difficult to apply and not feeling great once it's on my face, I'm not sure I would purchase it again, no matter how moisturizing it may be.

The product was interesting to apply and surprisingly fit well on my face with only a few inconsistencies. It felt moist on my face like gel as I let it dry for 30 minutes. It kept slipping off or becoming at times from parts of my face. After using the product, my skin felt smooth, but it caused me to break out with bumps on some parts of my face. I'm not sure if it was an allergic reaction or if my skin is too sensitive.

For the amount of time you're supposed to keep this on your face, I expected some good results on my skin afterward. While my face felt calm afterwards, there was really no visible result, such as skin clarity Even the mask didn't have any particles on it after to reflect removal of impurities. Other than that, it's a fine mask. It's a little tricky to put on since you need to remove the layers on top and bottom but also because it didn't fit to my face well, so I had to cut it to size. There isn't much of a smell to the mask. It has a fresh feel to it. This took the whole 30 minutes on my face before it started to dry a bit. As I mentioned, it's an ok product, but with no visible improvement and at this high price, I expected more.

avis.texte: These are overpriced face masks. They did absolutely nothing.

This is my first experience with a full-face peel-off mask. I typically use pore strips to target specific trouble spots like my nose and chin. Pore strips can be very adhesive and sometimes work too well leaving my skin irritated and red. These hypochlorous acid masks come sealed in individual packs, are premoistened, and have a protective backing on each side. The directions say to remove one protective layer, apply the mask then remove the other layer. The mask is very wet and flexible when applied and can be moved around and smoothed to fit and conform to the face. Directions say to leave the mask on for approximately 30 minutes. I found that in order for it to dry properly I needed to leave it on for 45 minutes. The smell of the mask as it dried was vaguely unpleasant to me, hard to describe, noticeable but not unbearable. The mask was not difficult or painful for me to remove and remained intact as I peeled it off. The directions also say to put the mask in water after use to see the results of the peel which I did. In my case I did not see sebum, skin cells or blackheads, I did however notice that my skin was vibrant and soft. The directions also do not say what to do to skin after removing the mask so after doing some online looking, I applied my usual moisturizers.

Medicube is a great Korean brand, and this product is nice, just wasn't my cup of tea. Each mask is a sheet mask that is 1 per pouch. The mask has 3 pieces, 2 outer pieces that are removed and you keep the center piece on your face which feels like a thin piece of fish skin. I don't mind the fish skin mask like texture, but it dried out within 5 minutes of usage where my skin was starting to feel dried out. Would say this is probably better for those with oily skin as wasn't the best for my dry skin (used after a shower and after toner was applied to face). That being said, it did not irritate my skin and while it was moist for the 3-5 minutes, it did feel nice and make my skin soft temporarily. However, would say again, not the best effectiveness for my face, no changes in brightness.

avis.titre: molds to skin and stays put, and makes great improvements in a short time. not drying at all!
avis.texte: I saw "hypochlorous acid" and jumped on these, because it is said to help with redness, and I have the most stubborn redness across my cheeks some days and it hasn't been an easy solve with anything at home or in-office...and those "color correctors" just tend to look like I slathered minty green paint on my face. When I got these and looked a bit closer, admittedly I was concerned about drying. I don't really have excess sebum, blackheads, or breakouts, and the instructions made it sound like this would act kind of like those nose strips that basically used to tear skin off my face. But, I'm down to try any skincare so long as the ingredients aren't total red flags, and these thankfully don't have anything I wouldn't want to put on my toe much less my face, so I soldiered on...and ended up being pleasantly surprised. Putting this mask on takes a bit of finesse. It is a very, very thin and clingy membrane-like mask stored between two meshlike sheets to keep it from sticking to itself, so you remove one side of the mesh, place it on your face, then remove the outer mesh and smooth it down. It immediately molds to my face and doesn't slide or gap, and feels comfortable on. It isn't dripping wet or sticky at all. I did have to make little snips so the eye holes were a bit larger, but face shapes vary so that won't be necessary for everyone. What stood out most to me is how fresh and refined my skin looked after using it. My pores looked a bit clearer, my skin felt smoother, and the overall texture of my complexion looked more even. It gives that clean, refreshed feeling that good Korean masks often deliver without leaving the skin tight or dry afterward. The formula also contains panthenol and hyaluronic acid, which help balance the treatment aspect with hydration. That’s important for mature skin because pore-refining or exfoliating products can sometimes be too drying. With this mask, my skin felt hydrated and comfortable after removing it. Another thing I like about Medicube masks is that they focus on visible skin improvement while still supporting skin health, and this one follows that same philosophy. avis.titre: Easy to Peel Off and Left My Skin Feeling Refreshed
avis.texte: I tried this peel-off sheet mask after a long day and honestly didn’t put as much effort into positioning it as I probably could have. The mask is pretty thin and flexible, so if you take the time you could probably adjust or trim it slightly to fit your face better. I was a bit tired and just went with “close enough,” but it still covered most of my face and stayed in place well while it dried. Also, remember there are 2 protective sheets, one on each side that need to be removed during the process. The instructions say to leave it on for about 30 minutes, but for me it took closer to 40 minutes to fully dry. I’m in a more humid environment, though, so that likely slowed the process a bit. Once it was ready, peeling it off was very easy. There wasn’t any uncomfortable tugging or irritation, which I sometimes worry about with peel-style masks. After removing it, I followed the instructions and lightly wet the mask, and I could see the dead skin and residue it had picked up. My skin felt clean and moisturized afterward rather than dry or tight. Overall, I was pretty happy with how it worked and even recommended it to a family member who was looking for masks that help with buildup and pores.

avis.titre: I am a spring roll and my skin feels incredible
avis.texte: Initially when I ordered this I gasped at the retail price. For three masks? You’ve gotta be kidding me! But after having tried them…. I get it. These are quite effective and feel really different from your traditional sheet mask. I’m going to try to describe this in a way that might be unusual but I promise it’s accurate. The actual mask literally feels like rice paper and I’m not even kidding. How you apply this to your face matters!!! The mask is enclosed between two protective films that have a bumpy mesh-like texture. I peeled off the first layer and then applied it to my face and THEN took off the other film. This mask is sooooo delicate I would not advise doing it any other way. And wow this thing stuck to my face like glue almost instantly. My picture doesn’t demonstrate how amazing the fit was because I wanted to show anyone reading this what the protective layer looked like (because it was confusing to me at first!) Results: skin felt refreshed and hydrated; a tiny bit sticky but tapping my fingers onto my skin after removal helped a bit with absorption. This is definitely a night time mask for me. Followed with the rest of my routine and I’m already looking forward to using another one next week!! Thanks Medicube for always helping reaffirm my love for Korean Beauty!!

avis.titre: Medicube Hypochlorous Acid Mask Targets Sebum with Hydrating Aftercare
avis.texte: The Medicube Hypochlorous Acid Peel Mask performs as a specialized treatment for managing excess sebum and refining the appearance of pores without the irritation of manual extraction. Each mask features a unique 1.5mm ultra-thin fit sheet that contours closely to the face, ensuring the Hypochlorous Acid works effectively to purify and calm the skin. I really like the visual "results check" where you can lightly wet the removed mask to see the impurities it collected during the 30-minute treatment. The quality of this mask is excellent because it balances deep clarifying care with a moisture-replenishing blend of Hyaluronic Acid, Ceramides, and Panthenol. It is a very practical choice for those with oily or blemish-prone skin who still want to maintain a hydrated and comfortable moisture barrier. The peel-off design is gentle enough for regular use and avoids the mess typically associated with traditional clay or liquid peel-off masks. At $21.80 for a 3-count set, this product offers excellent value for a high-tech Korean skincare treatment that addresses blackheads and skin clarity in one step. It is a dependable choice for achieving a smoother, more refined complexion as part of a weekly self-care routine. If you are looking for a professional-grade pore treatment that delivers visible results without stripping the skin, this Medicube peel mask is a solid pick.

avis.titre: The peel-off moment is so satisfying
avis.texte: I went into this skeptical. There are way too many sheet masks that feel like they do nothing. This is not one of those. You leave it on for about 30 minutes, and then you actually peel it off - and that part is incredibly satisfying. It comes off cleanly and leaves my skin looking clearer and more refreshed. My complexion just looked more awake afterward. Definitely read the instructions before applying. It’s not immediately obvious that the textured outer fabric layers are meant to be peeled away from the actual mask. I had to work a bit to separate them the first time. I’d recommend loosening both protective layers before placing the mask on your face, because once it’s on, that final layer is harder to grab. Overall, this felt like a well-designed mask and one I’d happily use again.

I love to try new masks and I’ve found that the best skin products are from Korea. This is another great skin care product from Korea. This is a box of 3 individually wrapped hypochlorous acid peel masks. In addition, these masks contain witch hazel for tightening and hyaluronic acid. I removed one mask from the packet and aligned it over my clean face. After adjusting it, I just laid down for a half hour to relax and let it work. After 30 minutes, I began to peel the mask from my face. It’s amazing to see all the hidden gunk that I wasn’t even aware was on my skin. My facial skin felt super clean, and the skin was so soft. I had no irritation at all from using the mask. At a bit over $7.00 per mask, it is less costly than going for a professional facial.

This mask felt fine on, didn’t bother my skin at all. It was stiffer than most facial masks. It was quite easy to put on. It stayed put well. It was thick and of good quality. My face had a really nice glow after using.

avis.titre: Thinnest mask you’ll ever use with incredible hydration!
avis.texte: This mask offers a completely unique experience compared to the traditional sheet masks we’ve seen over the past few years. Instead of being saturated in serums or liquids, this is a “dry” mask. Making it incredibly easy to use and exceptionally convenient. Yet the gel mask is loaded with incredibly hydrating ingredients. The mask itself is thinner & feels very gel like. Once applied has a transparent appearance on your skin. Even the application process feels innovative. This mask features a three layer system, with two extremely thin, cloth like protective layers. These delicate layers protect the gel mask and make the entire experience feel distinct from anything else on the market. While the format is very unique, it’s a very welcome change. There’s no dripping serum, no sticky residue, and no need to sit perfectly still. The mask adheres beautifully to the skin. This rescue mask doesn’t budge, slip, or slide. Once it’s on, you can comfortably move around and go about your routine or activities. Having this flexibility, I was able to brush my teeth, fold laundry, tidy up, and prepare for the next day while wearing the mask. It’s such a refreshing contrast to the more recent traditional masks that require you to sit still & wait to avoid it from slipping. The medicine mask is designed for urgent skin concerns and is formulated with hypochlorous acid, known for soothing red, itchy, or irritated skin.
